host_owned_invariants: Claim IDs are exact subset of frozen approved ledger and hashed host evidence; no added factual outcomes.
All declared before/after witness transformations reference persistent existing objects and known finite renderer capabilities.
Object identity preserved by deterministic host ID mapping; any split/merge needs explicit multiplicity map.
Narration beat ordering derived from verified audio/frame schedule, not model-invented seconds.
A visual representation is no-op/unsafe if its decoded witness cannot establish the pedagogical claim: reject it, never label creative PASS.
Any unsupported operation yields UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY with may_publish=false unless a validated semantically-equivalent alternative exists.
V2 Core receives unchanged data/protocol; V3 sidecar is opt-in and separate from legacy VisualDirectorOutput.
Human comprehension is UNRATED unless independently collected; renderer-level pixel change alone insufficient.

Counterexample from verified 3B1B Read: Euler e chapter acknowledges a geometric visualization is not always available and switches to numerical exploration. Motion is not mandatory; a static/symbolic witness is valid if it conveys an evidence-backed distinction.

Counterexample from Fourier Read: a formula may be displayed as an intentional unanswered teaser before its symbols are unpacked. Require narration to label teaser as unresolved, not forcibly rewrite all lessons to visual-before-formal.
Never award a static explanatory comparison or intentional quiz hold a fake before/after motion witness; transformed-object and static proof paths require different QA/critic contracts.
